title: The Strongest Demon King at 0 Months Old: Reincarnated with a Cheat Ability to Get Stronger Just by Eating, But Since I'm a Baby, I'll Grow Up on the Breast Milk of Heroes and Become Unrivaled!
description:
A 35-year-old man who lost his life had only one wish: 'to be loved by a family.' That wish was granted.
In an unprecedented reincarnation — inside the womb of the Demon Queen, Luciela. After a fetal life filled with legendary-grade ingredients, the strongest baby, Awsal Ambrose, `bursts onto the scene,' fully equipped with cheat skills!
author: Mikawa Gosuto
